name: @aexhq/conformance
description: Public conformance matchers for aex-compatible event streams and structured errors.

scripts.build:parity-deps: bun run --cwd ../.. --filter @aexhq/sdk build && bun run --cwd ../.. --filter @aexhq/cli build
scripts.test:unit: bun run build:parity-deps && mkdir -p .tmp && bun test --isolate --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=.tmp/junit-test-unit.xml && node ../../scripts/cicd/assert-no-skips.mjs .tmp/junit-test-unit.xml
